name: dockterm
description: SSH workspace for macOS, Windows & Linux — custom ~/.ssh/config hosts, snippets, command history, multi-tab sessions, and process tools
author: DockTerm

scripts.dev: PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin:$PATH concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:app: PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin:$PATH concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run runtime:node && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run runtime:node && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run runtime:node && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run runtime:node && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run runtime:node && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && npm run runtime:node && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir --publish never
